question: Should the applications here follow the established Gāyatrī procedures without doubt?
premises: Applications are to be performed in this context.
They should be done in the same way as for the Gāyatrī.
The text explicitly denies any doubt.
inference: The applications here must be performed just like those of the Gāyatrī, without doubt.
plain_english: Here one should likewise perform the applications as for the Gāyatrī; there is no doubt.
